---
title: "Open Mic Map"
subtitle: "Every mic on the list, plotted"
---

<!--
The pins on this map are auto-generated from the open mic listing sheet
(see scripts/generate_content.py -> build_map_data). Coordinates come
from OpenStreetMap's free Nominatim geocoder and are cached in
_generated/geocode-cache.json, so re-runs only look up brand-new
addresses instead of re-geocoding everything every time.
-->

::: {.aside-note}
Pins are placed automatically from each venue's address and won't be
perfectly precise everywhere — click a pin for details, or head to the
[full list](open-mics.qmd) for everything in table form.
:::

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" />

<div id="openmic-map" style="height: 650px; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(91,127,166,0.4);"></div>

{{< include _generated/openmics-map.qmd >}}

<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
<script>
(function() {
  var points = window.BC_MIC_LOCATIONS || [];
  var map = L.map('openmic-map').setView([39.29, -76.61], 9); // roughly centered on Baltimore

  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png', {
    attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors &copy; <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>',
    maxZoom: 19,
  }).addTo(map);

  var bounds = [];
  points.forEach(function(m) {
    var marker = L.circleMarker([m.lat, m.lng], {
      radius: 7,
      color: '#b98aff',
      weight: 1,
      fillColor: '#b98aff',
      fillOpacity: 0.85,
    }).addTo(map);

    var popup = '<strong>' + m.name + '</strong>';
    if (m.venue) popup += '<br>' + m.venue;
    if (m.weekday_name) popup += '<br>' + m.weekday_name + (m.time ? ' ' + m.time : '');
    if (m.link) popup += '<br><a href="' + m.link + '">Details &amp; sign-up →</a>';
    marker.bindPopup(popup);

    bounds.push([m.lat, m.lng]);
  });

  if (bounds.length) {
    map.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: [30, 30], maxZoom: 12 });
  }
})();
</script>

</div>
